quotes.text: The nonselection context-menu test right-clicks a row outside the current selection. It checks that only the target row gets .context-menu-target and that the override is cleared after the menu closes, the original selection and folder-tab focus return, and the opened tab contains the clicked message rather than the selected message. The patch removes a preference-based background-tab setup because the action itself now defines focus. A remaining TODO explicitly says Shift foreground behavior is not covered by this test, while the separate context-menu test adds a Shift case. When changing this path, protect selection, focus, and message identity together.
